The Four Provinces: The Sacred Heartlands of Akhratia
The Four Provinces  Letent, Glade, Odepa, and Rhaggue  have for centuries formed the cultural, spiritual, and economic foundation of the Akhratian Empire. Bound together under the guidance of the Imperial House of Vulpéčená, they are more than territories: they are the living memory of our civilization and the holiest lands of the Celestine faith.
Letent  Guarding the Empires northern frontier, Letent is a province of soaring peaks, glacial rivers, and mountain monasteries. Its high valleys cradle the Sanctuary of the First Light, the most sacred site in all of Celestine  believed to be where the heavens first touched the earth and bestowed divine blessing upon the Akhratian people. Pilgrims travel across continents to walk the sanctuarys ancient stone steps, seeking the same light that shone upon the first prophets.
Glade  To the west, Glade stretches in golden plains and fertile farmlands, famed for sustaining the Empires earliest generations. It was in Glade that the first imperial charter was signed, uniting Akhratias tribes beneath the Vulpéčená crown. The province is home to the Hall of Concord, where Celestine tradition holds that the founding rulers received divine guidance in forging the realm. Even today, Glade is seen as the Empires granary and a symbol of unity blessed by heaven.
Odepa  The eastern province of Odepa is a land of forests, rivers, and scholarly cities, long regarded as the Empires center of learning. Its great libraries hold illuminated manuscripts of the Celestine canon alongside the philosophical works of countless cultures. Odepas Monastery of the Sapphire Veil is revered in Celestine tradition as the place where the Prophet Arien meditated for forty days, emerging with visions that shaped the faiths sacred calendar.
Rhaggue  To the south lies Rhaggue, the only coastal province of Akhratia, where verdant hills roll down to the azure sea. For Celestines, Rhaggue is the site of the Garden of the Four Winds, a place where the sea breezes are believed to carry prayers directly to the divine. The coastal city of Velthar serves as the chief port for pilgrims arriving from distant lands, making Rhaggue not just a holy place but the Empires gateway to the world.

The Sacred Unity of the Provinces Though diverse in landscape and custom, the Four Provinces are united by the Celestine faith, which recognizes them collectively as the Blessed Quadran  the lands most favored by the divine. For six centuries, they have been the heart of Akhratias identity, bound together by faith, trade, and the enduring rule of the Vulpéčená dynasty.
